dataset.name: PAIRS
dataset.description: Original PAIRS release: 200 Midjourney-generated 256×256 PNGs across 50 everyday scenarios, each with four parallel prompt variants. Demographic names record prompt text, never a ground-truth identity inferred from an image. The local preview contains the first 20 complete occupation groups and five complete status groups, excluding potential-crime scenarios from the publication candidate.

rights.attribution: Kathleen C. Fraser and Svetlana Kiritchenko, PAIRS (2024)
rights.basis: Author datasheet Distribution section applies CC BY 4.0 to dataset and states authors own generated images; prompted demographic words are not human identity labels.
rights.use_note: Authors advise evaluation use and warn against using these data to predict a depicted person’s race or gender.

fields.name: scenario
fields.description: Author scenario folder; each scenario has four parallel prompt variants

fields.name: prompt_race
fields.description: Race word specified in generation prompt, not an inferred personal identity

fields.name: prompt_gender
fields.description: Gender word specified in generation prompt, not an inferred personal identity

sampling.population: original PAIRS commit: 200 images/50 four-image scenarios
sampling.selection_note: Purposeful source-section order: all 20 occupation groups, then five status groups, four prompt variants per scenario. Potential-crime scenarios are omitted from this preview because isolated display can amplify stereotypes; all 200 remain available locally.
